name: Building and Deploying AI-Enabled Medical Devices
description: A job-by-job course for the people inside a device manufacturer who build, clear, change and monitor AI-enabled software. You carry one fictional CT hemorrhage-triage device through the predicate table, the sequestered test set, the ISO 14971 and IEC 62304 files, the performance study, the Section 524B package, a PCCP, drift monitoring and MDR complaint triage, using synthetic data throughout.
fieldOfStudy: AI in Health and Life Sciences

image.caption: Wirewalk Institute of AI badge: Building and Deploying AI-Enabled Medical Devices

criteria.narrative:
To earn this certificate a learner must: complete all 23 lessons in 6 modules, play each of the course's 7 Decision Labs to an ending (the lab score does not count); and pass the final exam: 20 questions, 40 minutes, pass mark 80%, at most 3 attempts, with a 24-hour wait after a failed attempt.

The exam is taken online and is not proctored. The holder's identity is not verified; the name is the one on their account. This is a certificate of completion and assessment issued by Wirewalk Institute of AI. It is not an accreditation, academic credit, license, or a certification from any vendor. Details: https://institute.wirewalk.com/certification/#limits
